target_module: src/render/batch.ts (proposed; no src/fight or origins module fits client rendering)
best_idea: Collect a frame's opaque draws, sort them by a state key (texture, flags, colour, shader), issue one draw per run of equal state, and count the draw calls so the budget is a number a test can check.
decision_why: The collect, sort-by-state, flush-on-change shape and the per-frame draw-call counter fit a browser renderer that needs a testable budget for many-on-one scenes; the hand-rolled vertex copy does not, because the renderer already owns materials and instances, and the donor's ordering defects must be fixed in the design.
acceptance: A dev overlay prints draw calls per frame for the Pit and a zone, and a test asserts that N enemies sharing one material produce one draw call and that changing one enemy's material adds exactly one.
